subject.title: [Feature]: Silent reasoning — exclude thinking content from session transcript

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class transcript-persistence policy for thinking blocks, and should provider-required replay state be preserved separately from user/history transcript surfaces?
rationale: The source evidence shows the request is not a missing one-line filter; it requires a product/API decision across config, durable storage, provider replay, transcript APIs, compaction, ACP, and memory consumers.

options.title: Add first-class persistence policy
options.body: Create a schema-backed policy that discards thinking from user/history/memory transcript surfaces while explicitly preserving any provider-required replay state through a separate contract.

options.title: Keep plugin-hook workaround
options.body: Leave core storage unchanged and document before_message_write or memory-plugin filtering as the supported workaround, accepting continued context and transcript API pollution.

options.title: Defer durable hiding
options.body: Do not add silent reasoning until provider replay contracts and storage migration work are redesigned more broadly.

recommendation.title: Add first-class persistence policy
recommendation.body: Create a schema-backed policy that discards thinking from user/history/memory transcript surfaces while explicitly preserving any provider-required replay state through a separate contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on transcript-policy and reasoning replay behavior.
